versions.content: If a key was identified by its ID and either RequestDataPtr and RequestDataLength indicates data or KeyM_KH_Update() has returned E_OK and ResultDataPtr and ResultDataLengthPtr indicates data and the configuration /Key MCryptoKey/KeyMCryptoKeyGenerationType is set to KEYM_STORED_KEY, then this function shall call Csm_KeyElementSet() to provide the data to CSM. The key element ID is always 1 and the KeyMCryptoKeyCsmKeyTargetRef is used to identify the target key.
